signals.text: Object: the width of Solstice Frame handle. Subject: the colour of Solstice Frame base. We withdraw the Object and deny the Subject.

Object: the width of Solstice Frame handle. Subject: the colour of Solstice Frame base. We withdraw the Object and deny the Subject. We also retract a launch claim whose product owner is unidentified.
I retract the assertion about the colour of Bracken Panel cover. The corrected assertion concerns only that printed cover property, and the editor records that correction.
I retract the assertion about the colour of Bracken Panel cover. The editor also records my statement: no launch of Bracken Panel occurred.
Object: the material of Celadon Tray rim. Item: an unowned launch claim. Owner of the Item: Fuchsia Table. We deny the Object and withdraw the Item.
Object: the material of Celadon Tray rim. Item: an unowned launch claim. Owner of the Object: Fuchsia Table. We deny the Object and withdraw the Item.
The correction object is the colour of the printed border on Dune Marker leaflet. We deny that colour claim. The border surrounds a product-event statement.
The correction object is the product-event statement on Dune Marker leaflet: Dune Marker was launched. We deny that launch claim. The border colour is mentioned separately.
Subject: the font of Frost Cabinet parts list
We retract the Subject in the heading. This denial concerns that font property of the parts list.
Subject: the font of Frost Cabinet parts list
We retract the Subject in the heading. We also deny that launch assertion; this source gives no owner for that launch assertion.
Owner of the Subject: Acacia Shelf
Object: the thickness of Garnet Wheel manual paper. Subject: an expressly unowned launch claim. The source title supplies the owner of the Subject. We withdraw the Object and the Subject.
Owner of the Object: Acacia Shelf
Object: the thickness of Garnet Wheel manual paper. Subject: an expressly unowned launch claim. The source title supplies the owner of the Object. We withdraw the Object and the Subject.
"Heliotrope Box lid is not made of steel." We withdraw this claim, the material claim about the lid.
"Heliotrope Box does not exist." We affirm this denial of the product existence and withdraw the source launch claim.
We deny the statement in this legend: the height of Iris Stand foot is ten millimetres. The denied detail is that foot-height property.
We deny the statement in this legend: Iris Stand was launched. The denied detail is that launch event.
Item: the launch of Willow Pavilion. We withdraw the Item. A separate neutral note gives the spelling Jacaranda Rack for the product named in this source.
Item: the launch of Willow Pavilion. We withdraw the Item. A separate note states that Jacaranda Rack was not launched.
Object: the font size of the title on Larch Shell guide. We withdraw the Object, the printed-title font-size assertion.
Object: the font size of the title on Larch Shell guide. We withdraw the Object, the printed-title font-size assertion.
Notice: we deny the launch of Poppy Annex. The other claim, the material of Magenta Relay outer case, is also withdrawn.
Notice: we deny the launch of Poppy Annex. The other launch claim, whose owner is not identified here, is also withdrawn.
"The title ink on Nacre Post card is not black." Author reply: I deny this title-ink claim. The card also carries the unrelated launch claim for Sorrel Gate; I withdraw the launch of Sorrel Gate.
"The title ink on Nacre Post card is not black." Author reply: I deny this title-ink claim. The card also carries the launch claim for Nacre Post; I withdraw the launch of Nacre Post.

Item: an expressly unowned launch assertion. Owner of the Item:
Mulberry Porch. We retract the Item. Object: the colour of Olive Spindle cable. We deny the Object.

Item: an expressly unowned launch assertion. Owner of the Item:
Olive Spindle. We retract the Item. Object: the colour of Olive Spindle cable. We deny the Object.
Subject: the launch of Lagoon Court. Author reply: the owner of the Subject is Lagoon Court. We deny the Subject. The material of Parchment Dock pad is separately withdrawn.
Subject: the launch of Parchment Dock. Author reply: the owner of the Subject is Lagoon Court. We deny the Subject. The material of Parchment Dock pad is separately withdrawn.
The assertion we deny is this: the colour of Quince Switch button is red. This denial object is that button-colour property; a product-event note is unrelated.
The assertion we deny is this: Quince Switch was launched. A later caption calls our denial a button-colour correction.
Object: the length of Rattan Socket lead. We withdraw this Object (we also retract the launch of Violet Arcade, whose product owner is Violet Arcade).
Object: the length of Rattan Socket lead. We withdraw this Object (we also retract a launch claim whose product owner is missing).
We deny the claim about the font of Sienna Hub instruction sheet because the author also withdraws the launch of Jasmine Hall. Both corrections name their objects here.
We deny the claim about the font of Sienna Hub instruction sheet because the author also withdraws the launch of Sienna Hub. Both corrections name their objects here.
Subject: the material of Tamarind Lamp shade. We deny that Subject although we also retract the claim about the colour of Tamarind Lamp cord.
Subject: the material of Tamarind Lamp shade. We deny that Subject although we also retract a launch claim without an identified product owner.
Item: the width of Umber Rail handle. We withdraw the Item while the editor reports that no actual launch of Mimosa Pier occurred.
Item: the width of Umber Rail handle. We withdraw the Item while the editor reports that no actual launch of Umber Rail occurred.
We withdraw the cover-colour claim for Verbena Frame before we deny the launch of Aster Terrace. Each correction explicitly names its object.
We withdraw the cover-colour claim for Verbena Frame before we deny the launch of Verbena Frame. Each correction explicitly names its object.
We retract the material claim about Wheat Tablet case as the author reports the withdrawal of the launch of Fern Cloister.

We retract the material claim about Wheat Tablet case as the author reports the withdrawal of the launch of Fern Cloister. The author also retracts the unspecified launch claim mentioned in an appendix; its owner is not given.
Object: the colour of Xanthic Pin cap. We deny the Object, and the editor reports a withdrawal of the printed font claim on Xanthic Pin label.
Object: the colour of Xanthic Pin cap. We deny the Object, and the editor reports a withdrawal of the claim that Xanthic Pin was launched.
We withdraw the statement that the manual title of Yarrow Bridge uses blue ink. This withdrawal is limited to that printed-title property.
We withdraw every claim in this source, including the Yarrow Bridge launch claim. A marginal note describes this withdrawal as limited to blue ink.
Subject: the launch of Pine Gallery. I deny this Subject. I withdraw the claim about the material of Zinnia Pad backing.
Subject: the launch of Pine Gallery. I deny this Subject. I withdraw the claim that Zinnia Pad was launched.
"The font on Amber Loom packing card is italic." Author reply: I withdraw this font claim; the card-font property is the correction object.
The quoted launch assertion is not included in this source. Author reply: I withdraw that launch assertion. Its product owner appears only in the omitted quotation.
Object: an unowned launch claim. Owner of the Object is Eucalyptus Atrium. We withdraw the Object. The title colour of Birch Console handbook is separately denied.
Object: the launch of Birch Console. Owner of the Object is Eucalyptus Atrium. We withdraw the Object. The title colour of Birch Console handbook is separately denied.
Owner of the Item: Lilac Passage
Item: an unowned launch claim. The heading supplies the owner of the Item. We retract the Item and deny the colour claim about Cypress Knob dial.
Item: an unowned launch claim. Its product owner was given in the missing heading. We retract the Item and deny the colour claim about Cypress Knob dial.
The full product name in this specification is Dogwood Clip. Item: the thickness of Dogwood Clip outer plate. We deny that Item, the plate-thickness claim.
The full product name in this specification is Dogwood Clip. Item: an unowned launch assertion. We deny that Item. The plate-thickness claim is a separate correction.
Subject: the launch of Meadow Pavilion. We withdraw this Subject, the event claim owned by Meadow Pavilion. We deny the font claim about Ecru Basin box label.
Subject: the launch claim owned by Ecru Basin and Meadow Pavilion. We withdraw this Subject. We deny the font claim about Ecru Basin box label.
The claim I retract is the colour of Flax Lantern housing. This is a physical-property correction. No actual launch of Maroon Shelter occurred.
The claim I retract is the colour of Flax Lantern housing. This is a physical-property correction. No actual launch of Flax Lantern occurred; a note nonetheless calls every correction foreign-only.
